items.statement: The submitted workflow optimizes the specified neutral singlet ion pair and validates the reported structure with harmonic frequencies.
items.expected: A converged optimization and an explicit imaginary-frequency count are documented.

items.statement: The submission selects the lowest-energy vertical singlet by excitation energy and separately identifies the largest-oscillator-strength state in the same documented list.
items.expected: The excitation list, energy-based selection rule and orbital contribution identify the lowest state; the intensity comparison must not relabel it as the strongest transition.

items.statement: The gas-phase AMP-TFA HOMO-LUMO gap is reproduced.
items.expected: The reported gap is approximately 6.008 eV.

items.statement: The first (lowest-energy) listed singlet UV transition is reproduced and assigned; it is not defined by maximum oscillator strength.
items.expected: The first listed source transition is approximately 271.84 nm and HOMO-to-LUMO / pi-to-pi-star; Table 4 gives f=0.0008, smaller than the second listed transition f=0.0013.
